observation_profile: monitor sample gap and sample-count rules
parameter_ownership.shared_safety_check: max_sample_gap_seconds is repeated defensively between trial safety and observation monitors, but LocalStepSessionReadiness requires exact equality

notes: 2.0 m3/h is the inherited first-phase manual identification candidate; it is not the runtime planner step cap.
Tracking reach tolerance, response baseline/window/delay parameters and action timeout are owned by the separate Observation Profile and are no longer duplicated here.
Trial-matrix max_step and trial-count/day requirements are owned by the Trial Matrix and are no longer duplicated here.
30 s max_sample_gap remains here only as a trial-safety check; readiness requires equality with all observation-monitor gap settings.
2700 s min_quiet is a REVIEW_CANDIDATE rounded above pulse-end-to-recovery-band P95 ~=2450 s; all fresh baseline gates must still pass.
A 300-second baseline audit found only three qualifying independent windows, so max_abs_inlet_so2_change remains null.
min_abs_delta_SO2/pH remain null because the CSV identifies a noise floor but does not choose the confidence multiplier.
Fields left null require plant review or new evidence.

trial_matrix.rule: No automatic 2->4->6 m3/h escalation. A later step level requires a separate human design review after Phase-1 evidence is complete.

historical_constraints.recovery_band_definition: pH <= pre-pulse baseline + 0.05 sustained for approximately 120 s; next pump action right-censors observation
historical_constraints.note: Pending rise, pulse recovery, Planner HOLD, observation-monitor design, trial-matrix design and noise evidence have separate parameter ownership.

required_preconditions: request explicitly enabled for a supervised identification session
condition snapshot and MFAC context available
actual flow and Qbase valid and sufficiently close
Qbase absolute and relative drift stable
pH inside a reviewed sub-band of the plant operating envelope and pH baseline stable
outlet SO2 retains a reviewed headroom to the plant safe maximum
no recent supply-flow action inside a reviewed quiet interval
inlet SO2 and outlet SO2 baseline sufficiently stable
proposed positive step remains inside plant supply-flow bounds
dual_response_success_criteria: SO2 and pH responses belong to the same actual-flow tracking event
safety summary belongs to the same approved trial
actual positive delta-Q matches the approved test step within reviewed tolerance
condition/context/target remain stable and there is no FAST overlap
SO2 response observation meets the reviewed minimum duration
pH response observation meets the reviewed minimum duration
pH remains inside the operating envelope throughout the monitored trial
phi_so2_event is negative and phi_ph_event is positive
SO2 and pH effects exceed separately reviewed minimum-effect thresholds
Qbase and inlet SO2 drift remain inside reviewed evidence limits
notes: No numeric value from unit tests is a site calibration default.
Identification Design, Observation Profile and Trial Matrix must all be reviewed and cross-profile consistent before a session is considered ready.
The +2.0 m3/h identification stimulus is never a 10-second recurrent increment.
PendingDoseGuard has no recovery-memory authority; trial quiet time is separately reviewed from pulse recovery evidence.
Production remains LEARN=0, Residual=0, DCS write=off.
